integrity: Original batch-reset model, exact one-/two-point stationary marginals and connected-density correlations credited to the motivating article. General common-noise empirical-density and weighted-exponential precedents acknowledged; the novelty assessment concerns the conditional full stationary random-measure law for interior batch fractions. Independent scientific review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed interior fraction 0<alpha<1 before the thermodynamic limit; sequential alpha-to-zero central limit, not a simultaneous joint limit; stationary independent Brownian particle dynamics with exact fixed-size random batch resetting. Classical abstract perpetuity small-ball mathematics is prior art.
title: Random stationary empirical density in a partially batch-reset Brownian gas
